data.body: Implementation child for hive-flow-1838. Build a scoped isolated pack-root harness and tests for Phase 2B C3: prepare a temp future hive-flow package root from the current CLI source, rewrite workspace:* specs to concrete source versions, bundle eager providers runtime without mutating repo node_modules, run dry-run and real npm pack, install the tarball into a temp prefix, probe hive-flow --version, provider bridge/journal imports, MCP server path availability, selected CLI exports, and exclusion rules. Route to Claude before landing.
data.title: Implement Phase 2B C3 pack smoke harness
